source: Findeter 2023 MIB Yopal, figures 30–32, original maps July 2017
method: SIFT affine alignment of historic maps; multi-scale optimization of OSM street-centerline samples against historic map ink; visual component review; approximate split of three merged symbols in route 3
limitations: No independent surveyed ground control RMSE; not verified current boarding locations or directions; raw icon centers, not snapped.
